Definition: County-year total of AP type labels for U.S. adaptation actions retained by the heat, hot, high-temperature or drought screen; summed across the four AP categories.
Data source: CDP data

Definition: County-year total of MP type labels for substantive U.S. emissions-reduction actions; all such actions were retained without a heat-keyword screen and summed across the four MP categories.
Data source: CDP data

Definition: Combined AP and MP policy-type-label counts. A single action may receive more than one policy-type label.
Data source: CDP data

Definition: Total county population in the migration flow-start year; used as the denominator for per-capita flow measures.
Data source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS five-year estimates

Definition: County median household income in nominal U.S. dollars, entered as the natural logarithm.
Data source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS five-year estimates

Definition: Share of the county population aged 65 years or older.
Data source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS five-year estimates

Definition: County shares for White, Black, American Indian/Alaska Native, Asian, Native Hawaiian/other Pacific Islander, other single-race and multiracial residents; Hispanic ethnicity is not a separate eighth race group.
Data source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS five-year estimates

Definition: Probability that two county residents selected at random belong to different race groups: 1 - sum of squared shares across the seven groups.
Data source: Calculated from ACS race-group shares

Definition: Share of county residents aged 25 years or older with a bachelor degree or higher.
Data source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS five-year estimates

Definition: Share of renter households with a computable rent-to-income ratio whose gross rent is at least 30% of household income.
Data source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS five-year estimates

Definition: County median monthly gross rent, including applicable utility costs, entered as the natural logarithm of nominal U.S. dollars.
Data source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS five-year estimates

Definition: County land-canopy percentage converted to canopy area divided by total county area, including land and water.
Data source: U.S. Forest Service annual 30-m tree-canopy product; TIGER/Line county area

Definition: Annual county house-price index entered as a natural logarithm; it measures price changes rather than dollar-valued house prices.
Data source: Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) House Price Index

Definition: Mapped footprints for libraries, community centers, social facilities, places of worship and malls, summed and divided by total county area.
Data source: Historical OpenStreetMap polygons via ohsome API; TIGER/Line county area

Definition: County renewable net generation divided by total net generation using the retained fuel-code grouping. Ratios slightly above 1 are capped at 1; counties without matched generation are assigned 0.
Data source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA-923 generation; EIA-860 plant locations)

Definition: Published number of individuals moving from origin county i to destination county j over the IRS filing-year interval; the IRS -1 suppression marker is treated as unavailable.
Data source: IRS county-to-county migration data

Definition: Published number of moving tax returns for a directed county flow, used as a household-flow proxy; the IRS -1 suppression marker is treated as unavailable.
Data source: IRS county-to-county migration data

Definition: Aggregate AGI reported on the IRS second filing-year return for migration-record filers, in thousands of nominal U.S. dollars. The -1 suppression marker is treated as unavailable; valid negative AGI values are retained.
Unit of measurement: Thousands of nominal US$ per directed flow
Data source: IRS county-to-county migration data

Definition: IRS n2 from origin i to destination j divided by origin population in the flow-start year; the regression outcome is ln(n2/population).
Data source: IRS n2; ACS population

Definition: IRS n1 from origin i to destination j divided by origin population in the flow-start year; the flow outcome is modeled in natural logarithms.
Data source: IRS n1; ACS population

Definition: Sum of positive IRS n2 counts across observed destinations divided by origin-county population.
Data source: IRS n2; ACS population

Definition: Aggregate AGI converted to nominal dollars and divided by n1; model outcome is asinh(mean AGI per return / US$10,000).
Unit of measurement: Nominal US$ per return; transformed outcome
Data source: IRS AGI and n1

Definition: Total AGI associated with a directed flow divided by origin population and expressed per 1,000 residents; model outcome is asinh(AGI intensity / US$10,000).
Unit of measurement: Nominal US$ per 1,000 origin residents; transformed outcome
Data source: IRS AGI; ACS population

Definition: Annual IRS n2 counts summed across county pairs within each directed origin-state and destination-state pair.
Data source: IRS n2; county-to-state mapping from TIGER/Line

Definition: Five ordered groups (Q1-Q5) formed separately from mean AGI, AGI intensity, person-flow rate and tax-return-flow rate.
Data source: Derived from IRS flow measures and ACS population
